name: Flapjack

source.concept: Flying stack of two pancakes with a butter pat, sleepy eyes and purple wings; bobs in the air.

behavior_contract: no gravity; bobs up and down around its placed height
stomp from above: defeated, player bounces
side contact: player restarts at checkpoint
frozen at its placed spot outside runs; resets to its placed spot each attempt
immune to normal damage (only course rules defeat it)
skin_slot: cc_flapjack.png (64x64 box-UV layout; hi-res multiples of the same layout allowed)
